world.name: Pan-Pacific Ledger Conduit
world.summary: Physical-data hybrid infrastructure: ~14,000 LEO cubesats coated in retroreflective metamaterial plus ground ceramic sensor posts every ~400m along ports, rail, and highways. Every object and many human actions are registered, timestamped, and monetized. Themes: systemic trust, engineered obsolescence, price of perfect recall.
